Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly standardized the birth date format from "11 September 1962" to "November 9, 1962" (MM/DD/YYYY format as 11/09/1962), misinterpreting the "11 September 1962" date as "November 9" instead of "September 11." This led to an incorrect understanding of the birth date, despite multiple reliable sources (Wikipedia and Discogs) confirming the correct date as September 11, 1962. This error could cause the final reported birth date to be inaccurate.
